tools.name: list_public_guidance
tools.description: List Available Re Culture™ Public Guidance For A Selected Language. Accepts Only en Or ar; Do Not Send Review Scenarios.

tools.name: get_public_guidance
tools.description: Retrieve A Versioned Re Culture™ Public Foundation, Example Set, Or Review Workflow In English Or Arabic With Source And Review Status. Use Only Topic And Language Selections.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_public_guidance, get_public_guidance · Public sink: list_public_guidance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_public_guidance, get_public_guidance · Public sink: list_public_guidance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
